critical_stages_order_of_importance.priority: CRITICAL - Most vital single irrigation. Skipping this reduces yield by 35% to 40% as crown root system fails to establish.
HIGH - Ensures maximum productive tillers per plant.
HIGH - Determines spikelet count and head size.
CRITICAL - Water stress here causes pollen sterility and poor fertilization.
MEDIUM - Grain filling and test weight. Avoid irrigating on windy days to prevent lodging.

contingency_limited_water: If only 1 irrigation is available: Apply strictly at CRI (21 DAS). If 2 irrigations are available: Apply at CRI (21 DAS) and Flowering (80 DAS). If 3 irrigations available: CRI, Jointing, and Flowering.

total_water_requirement: 650 to 750 mm across 6 to 9 irrigations (or drip)

critical_stages_order_of_importance.priority: MODERATE - Light irrigation; deep root development is encouraged by slight early moisture restriction.
HIGH - Water stress triggers premature square dropping.
CRITICAL - Water deficit severely impacts flower retention and fertilization.
CRITICAL - Determines boll weight, seed development, and fiber length.

drip_irrigation_guideline: Inline drip system with 16 mm lateral per paired row, dripper discharge 2.0 to 4.0 LPH at 60 cm spacing. Drip saves 40-50% water and boosts yield by 25%.
contingency_limited_water: Adopt alternate furrow irrigation or broad bed and furrow (BBF) to save 30% water while maintaining root aeration.

total_water_requirement: 500 to 650 mm; requires frequent light irrigations due to shallow fibrous root system

critical_stages_order_of_importance.priority: HIGH - Immediate irrigation upon transplanting, followed by life-saving irrigation on 3rd day.
critical_stages_order_of_importance.depth: Light furrow or drip 1.5 hr daily

critical_stages_order_of_importance.priority: CRITICAL - Moisture stress causes flower drop; over-watering triggers root rot.
CRITICAL - Fluctuation between extreme dry soil and heavy irrigation causes severe fruit skin cracking and Blossom End Rot (BER).

drip_irrigation_guideline: Use 25-30 micron silver-black plastic mulch with drip laterals beneath. Drip fertigation frequency: daily in summer, alternate days in winter.

total_water_requirement: 500 to 600 mm; high humidity (>70%) and warm conditions

critical_stages_order_of_importance.priority: HIGH - Needs moist topsoil. Pre-sowing irrigation is ideal. Avoid crust formation.
CRITICAL - Fast stem height growth requires continuous moderate moisture. Stagnant water must be drained for Olitorius jute.

contingency_limited_water: Pre-sowing irrigation ensures uniform stand. Jute tolerates later dry spells better than early drought.
